character.description: Lume, the hooded lunar archer: deep-violet hood, void-like face, silver-violet armor, ragged short cape, crescent longbow

idle.action: subtle breathing with the bow held stable; feet remain on the common baseline

walk.action: clear four-step walk cycle with planted foot contacts and no vertical scale change

run.action: compact running or retreat cycle with readable foot contacts and stable bow silhouette

attack_charge.action: raise crescent bow, nock, and draw toward the locked lane; feet stay planted

attack_execute.action: clean bow release and follow-through; no detached projectile or visual effect

recover.action: lower bow and return from follow-through to ready stance

hit.action: brief readable recoil while the bow remains held and full body remains visible

death.action: controlled collapse to the ground with no detached bow or body parts
